# scratch — developer sandbox executable
#
# Consumes the locally-built cppwinrt projection headers.

add_executable(scratch
    main.cpp
    pch.cpp
)

target_precompile_headers(scratch PRIVATE pch.h)

# The projection headers are generated by the `build-cppwinrt-projection` custom
# target defined in test/CMakeLists.txt; depend on it if tests are enabled.
if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_dependencies(scratch build-cppwinrt-projection)
    target_include_directories(scratch PRIVATE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/test/cppwinrt")
endif()

# Projection headers live next to the binary during development
target_include_directories(scratch PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cppwinrt"   # for the headers themselves when used stand-alone
)

target_link_libraries(scratch shlwapi)
